newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia women shown as sex objects in local media.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia women shown as sex objects in local media.

text.p: Women in Cambodia are typically portrayed in local newspapers as sex objects, thieves or victims of violence, a study released here on Thursday showed.
The study, called "The Portrayal of Women in the Khmer Press," was compiled by the Women's Media Centre, a recently established non-governmental organisation,
"We were quite shocked to find that the highest percentage of articles about women were in the obscene serialised story category," said Tive Sarayeth, director of the study.
She said fewer than one in 20 articles in local Cambodian newspapers mentioned women.
But when women do make the news, they are thieves, murderers or victims of violence, she said, adding that women fare particularly badly in cartoons and drawings.
Rarely are women portrayed as decision makers or forces for social change, the study found.
The study was based on the analysis of more than 30,000 stories in 46 local newspapers over eight months.
